chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام say: "Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام ruled regarding a man who is struck on his hips, so that he can no longer control his stool or his urine, that in such a case the full diyah is due."

key_terms.عَلَى عِجَانِهِ: on his hips or buttock area

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an injury causes permanent loss of control over urine and stool?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning bodily injury. If a blow causes a man to lose control over defecation and urination, the injury is treated as grave enough to require the full diyah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5282 - Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "The Commander of the Faithful (as) ruled regarding a man who was struck on his hips, causing him to lose control over his stool and urine, that the full blood money (diyya) is due for that."
